Built Atlas, an AI knowledge system that records how each customer’s use cases were solved, so any implementation manager can ask how a problem was handled before and get an answer that is still current.
Solution architect and implementation manager for Phase 2 of NICE, an enterprise account, integrating Rocketlane with ADP, SatMetrix, ServiceNow, and Salesforce.
Led enterprise CMMS implementations for mid-to-large clients across the UK, US, and Middle East — $4.1M+ in total contract value and nearly $1M in implementation and expansion value.

highlights:
Sales-to-Implementation Handover: Streamlines the transition from sales to implementation.
Kickoff Deck Generator: Generates customer kickoff presentations.
Workshop Planner: Prepares workshop sessions and generates post-session recaps.
Solution Design Agent: Generates solution design documents for each customer.
UAT Agent: Creates test scripts and test cases from design documents, scope documents, emails, and call transcripts.
Form-to-Sheets Agent: Transfers form responses into Rocketlane Sheets for reporting.

Problem: Native settings, notifications, and automations were configured manually after every design document.
Solution: Built a Nitro Workforce agent that reads design documents and determines the required configuration.
Browser Automation: Uses Browserbase to navigate Rocketlane, configure settings, and create automations.
Validation: Proof of concept subsequently validated by the product team.

Problem: Implementation knowledge was scattered across individual team members and unstructured documents.
Solution: Built Atlas, a centralized, searchable AI knowledge system for implementation use cases and solutions.
AI Architecture: A Lovable application with an Anthropic-hosted agent for use-case generation and a backend agent with custom skills for answering questions.
Knowledge Retrieval: Uses Supermemory to retrieve relevant information instead of loading the entire documentation corpus into the LLM.

Knowledge Capture: Extracts customer use cases and discussed solutions from Avoma call transcripts and Freshdesk tickets.
Solution Generation: Captures agreed solutions or proposes alternatives based on product documentation when no solution was discussed.
Human Review: Implementation Managers approve or revise generated use cases and solutions.
Solution Retrieval: Retrieves previously approved solutions when similar questions arise.
Current-State Validation: Checks historical solutions against Notion, Slack, Rocketlane projects, and product and API documentation to identify retired features and outdated approaches.

Response Caching: Reuses previous answers when the relevance match is 95% or higher.
Feedback Capture: Records positive and negative ratings for generated answers.
Failure Classification: A validator agent analyzes incorrect answers and classifies issues, such as missing data or missing context.
Admin Review: Routes flagged answers to an administrative queue for investigation.
Continuous Improvement: Helps administrators identify gaps in data sources, retrieval logic, and agent skills.

ADP: Integrates time-off and time-entry data.
SatMetrix: Triggers customer surveys and writes survey scores back to Rocketlane.
ServiceNow: Integrates support tickets and provides custom apps to view tickets against projects and customers.
Salesforce: Supports two-way risk management and partner resource requests.
Solution Ownership: Served as solution architect and implementation manager for Phase 2 of the enterprise NICE account.
On-site in Saudi Arabia for a half-million-dollar engagement and in the UK for MHA — requirement gathering, stakeholder workshops, and go-live training.
Converted pilots into full-scale enterprise rollouts through structured discovery and early value demonstration — $350K+ in expansion value.
Spotted unbilled scope changes, built a way to track them, and worked with Sales to introduce pre-purchased Professional Services credits — turning informal changes into billable work.

Scoped SSO (SAML/SCIM) and integrations with Xero, CorrigoPro, Equiem, Wooqer, Bill.com, SiteFotos, and SFG20 — validated APIs in Postman, chose polling vs webhook patterns, and wrote the specs for engineering.
projectDescriptions: Turns customer calls, tickets, Slack, and project docs into human-approved implementation solutions. Answers are checked against current product knowledge so retired features don’t resurface, and answers marked wrong are classified by a validator agent and routed to an admin review queue.
AI-powered assistant that lets support teams query enterprise platform configurations in natural language — eliminating dependency on implementation engineers post go-live.

Bridges the gap between raw trading interfaces and disciplined strategy-driven execution. Users define structured trading blueprints — AI monitors conditions, generates setups, and drafts trades for human approval.
